title: [Decision] `ChartSchema`'s real data model — chart-level `data` and `xAxisKey` — is undeclared, and #6896's retirement now points authors at it by name
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (session `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`) out of #6896's delivery. ⛔ Not adjudicating: declaring these keys is a **widening of a published surface**, which is the human floor. Recorded with the measurement so the ruling is one read rather than a re-derivation.

## The gap, stated plainly

#6896 retires `ChartDataSeries.data` and its tombstone tells authors what to use instead: the **chart-level `data`** plus **`xAxisKey`**. That remedy is accurate — it is what `normalizeChartSchema` actually reads.

⚠️ **Neither key is declared on `ChartSchema`.** Both survive only through `BaseSchema`'s `[key: string]: any` index signature.

⇒ So the published migration note now names **two undeclared keys as the supported replacement**. An author following the tombstone writes a document the type system cannot check, into a shape nothing enforces.

## Why this is the same defect one level out

#6896's whole subject is declared-but-unread. This is its mirror: **read-but-undeclared**. The de-facto contract — chart-level `data` + per-series `dataKey`, which the ruling itself called *"the de-facto contract"* — rides an index signature, so:

- `ChartSchema` literals are **not excess-property-checked**, so a misspelled `xAxiskey` or `datas` type-checks green and renders an empty chart;
- the zod mirror does not model it either, so `safeValidateSchema` cannot refuse it;
- ⇒ the one shape the platform actually supports is the one shape an AI author gets no feedback on.

## What was measured, and by whom

Measured by the #6896 dev while implementing the ruling (report on that card): `normalizeSeries` reads nine keys and `data` is not among them; rows come from the chart-level `data`; the category axis comes from `xAxisKey` / `xAxis`. Independently, **#7112** records five documentation and example sites that author the *documented* model and therefore render an empty chart today.

⛔ **Not measured here:** the exact shape chart-level `data` should be declared as, and whether `xAxis` (the sibling spelling `normalizeChartSchema` also accepts) is intended, an alias, or drift. That is part of what a ruling has to settle.

## The decision

**Should `ChartSchema` declare the data model it actually reads?**

| | option | note |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | Leave undeclared | The remedy text stays accurate about behaviour; the gap persists and the retirement's migration target remains uncheckable |
| **B** | Declare chart-level `data` and `xAxisKey` (and settle `xAxis`) on `ChartSchema` and its zod mirror | Makes the model the retirement migrates authors **to** enforceable rather than merely documented. ⚠️ A published-surface **widening** ⇒ human floor + `needs:contract-review` |
| **C** | Declare them inside #6896's PR | ⛔ Explicitly rejected by that card's dev and by this seat: it would put a widening and a narrowing into one review, and the ruling authorised the narrowing only |

## 四维分析

**① 实际业务需求** —— 拉动是**实测的**,不是推测:这两个键就是渲染器今天读的东西,#7112 记录的五处 doc/example 站点全都在教**另一个**(已退役的)模型,今天渲染出空图。⇒ 需求不在「要不要支持」——已经支持了;在于「支持的东西要不要可检查」。

**② 项目长远合理性** —— B 是 contract-first 的读法。#6896 关掉了「声明了却没人读」的一半,留下「读了却没声明」的另一半;两半是同一个 ADR-0049 形状。⚠️ 只关一半,等于把作者从一个不可检查的模型迁移到**另一个**不可检查的模型。

**③ 防 AI 写错** —— 这一轴最硬,而且决定问题。`ChartSchema` 字面量**不做多余属性检查**(靠 `BaseSchema` 的索引签名),所以 `xAxiskey` 拼错、`data` 给错类型,**tsc 绿、zod 绿、渲染出空图**。这正是「AI 声明一个运行时不兑现的能力」的反向:AI 写对了意图、拼错了键,而平台**一声不吭**。B 让它在作者期响亮。

**④ 创业阶段不扩散** —— ⚠️ 这一轴指向克制,必须诚实呈现:B 是**加宽已发布面**,而本轮的裁决刚刚以「zero users 不建新机制」为由退役了另一半。⇒ 但 B 不新增能力,它把**已经在跑的**能力写成声明;这与「扩散需求」不同,更接近 declared = enforced 的恢复。判断权在维护者。

**推荐:B**,弱持。①②③ 同向,④ 是真实的反对但性质是「写下既有事实」而非「新增能力」。⛔ 四棱非同向 ⇒ 不代裁。

⚠️ **不占工期**:#6896 的 PR 不等这张卡,它已按裁决完成并停在契约复审前(另因 fable 额度受阻)。

## Related
